query: A car dealership manages the sales of various car models with revenue data provided in the ‘Revenue’ column. The dealership aims to maximize total revenue using the initial inventory of car models classified under ‘FDK57’. Inventory levels are detailed in the ‘Initial Inventory’ column. Demand quantities are specified in the ‘Demand’ column and are assumed to be deterministic and known in advance. Decision variables x_i represent the quantity of each ‘FDK57’ car model i that the dealership plans to fulfill.
